proposed.text: An accessible route corridor inside a building must accommodate two-way wheelchair and pedestrian traffic. What is the minimum clear width required, and what additional element must be provided at dead ends?

options.text: 1800 mm minimum clear width; no additional turnabout required if the corridor is wide enough
1200 mm minimum clear width; a 1500 × 1500 mm turnabout space within 5000 mm of the dead end
1500 mm minimum clear width; a 1800 × 1800 mm turnabout space within 3500 mm of the dead end
1500 mm minimum clear width; a 1500 × 1500 mm turnabout space anywhere along the corridor

proposed.rationale: Accessible corridor: 1500 mm wide; 1800 × 1800 mm turnabout within 3500 mm of dead end. The 1500 mm corridor width supports two-way wheelchair and pedestrian movement. At dead ends, a 1800 × 1800 mm turnabout space must be provided within 3500 mm of the end so a wheelchair user does not have to reverse the full corridor length. The 3500 mm proximity requirement is explicit in the BP 344 Appendix B text. A 1500 × 1500 mm space is insufficient for a full 180° wheelchair turn.
proposed.explanation: Accessible corridor: 1500 mm wide; 1800 × 1800 mm turnabout within 3500 mm of dead end per BP 344.
